value.name: Asha arranges Lucia's ride
value.description: Asha tells Lucia that a ride is coming and instructs her to bring her ID, while withholding whose car it will be.
evidence: She told Lucia a ride was coming and to bring her ID, and did not yet say whose car it would be.

value.name: Asha calls Rosa for help
value.description: Asha phones Rosa and tells her Lucia must reach a notary within ninety minutes and that Daniel will not be driving her.
evidence: Asha picked the phone back up and called Rosa, and when Rosa answered on the first ring Asha said only that Lucia needed to be at a notary in the next ninety minutes and that Daniel was not driving her.

value.name: Rosa agrees to handle the pickup
value.description: Rosa immediately understands the urgency, says she will handle Lucia's transportation, and ends the call before Asha can thank her.
evidence: Rosa took a breath that meant she had already been halfway to her keys, and said she would handle it, and hung up before Asha could thank her.

value.name: Rosa pressures Daniel for the address
value.description: Asha imagines Rosa calling Daniel, demanding Lucia's pickup address and naming the notary deadline so he cannot stall.
evidence: A minute later, with her father's hand still under her palm, Asha heard the rest of it secondhand through the thin wall of her own imagining: Rosa calling Daniel and demanding Lucia's pickup address straight out, no preamble, the notary's window named down to the minute so he could not pretend the timing was negotiable.

value.name: Daniel gives Rosa the pickup address
value.description: Daniel relents and provides the address, allowing Rosa to text Asha that the ride is already on the way.
evidence: Whatever Daniel said back, he gave her the address; Rosa texted Asha a single line a moment later, on the way, which was all Asha needed to know that the signature would be where it had to be before the cutoff.

value.name: Asha calls Marcus for the deposit
value.description: Asha contacts Marcus and demands that his half of the deposit be wired to the Bridgepoint account before five, giving him the routing numbers like a client.
evidence: Asha shifted her palm to her father's wrist and dialed Marcus, and when he answered she did not waste the opening: Lucia held the proxy, the signature was already on its way to a notary, and she needed his half of the deposit wired to the Bridgepoint account before five.
She gave him the routing numbers slowly, the way she would read them to a client
